visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The interviewee, a young man with long dark wavy hair, is shown in a medium shot. He wears a plain black sweatshirt and a silver cross necklace. He stands against a gray stone wall outdoors. A hand enters the frame holding a yellow microphone. He smiles as he shares his unique name. (2) The interviewer, a man in a green flight jacket, is shown laughing and holding a clipboard. They are standing on a sidewalk. The interviewer is visibly excited, gesturing frequently. He asks to see the interviewee's ID card to verify the unusual name while maintaining a high-energy interaction. (3) A close-up shot features a hand holding up a Taiwan National Health Insurance card, clearly displaying the name 「鄭方形」. The interviewee then explains his father's intentions while gesturing with his hands. He mentions his brother's name and his future plans for his son's name, all while smiling. (4) The interviewer laughs heartily and hands a small circular yellow badge to the interviewee as a reward for his family's 'punny' names. The interviewee holds the badge and smiles. Large text overlays appear on the screen to conclude the humorous segment in a variety show style.
